title: Criterion adjudication outcomes
description: The answers an adjudicator may give when a reviewer or author disagrees with ONE QA criterion's finding. Declared by Process_CriterionAdjudication; each code selects the work that follows it.

source.note: named by #1019 (bean 5vo9); moved to the QA-criterion specialisation by bean bvuk, 2026-09-23

codes.label: The finding stands
codes.definition: The criterion applies to this subject and its finding is right; the subject is what changes.

source.note: bean bvuk; owner approved the answer set 2026-09-23

codes.label: The criterion does not apply here
codes.definition: The criterion is scoped so it stops applying to subjects like this one: one edit to the criterion rather than repeated overrules on blocks it should never have covered.

codes.label: It applies; this is an exception
codes.definition: The rule applies and this subject is a stated exception. The dispensation carries its reason and lapses when the source changes, so it is scoped to the version it was granted for.
